changes.summary: From January 28 through July 4, 2027, the Musée des Arts Décoratifs presents Le monde de Viktor&Rolf. 30 ans de haute couture, a major retrospective dedicated to the Dutch design duo Viktor Horsting and Rolf Snoeren. Originally conceived by the Kunsthalle München and curator Thierry-Maxime Loriot in close collaboration with the House of Viktor&Rolf, the Paris presentation traces more than three decades of work that has continually pushed the boundaries between fashion, art, and performance. Featuring more than 100 haute couture creations, the designers’ iconic miniature dolls, archival materials, and immersive installations, the exhibition invites visitors into the singular world of Viktor&Rolf. It highlights a creative practice that seamlessly combines exceptional craftsmanship, theatricality, and conceptual innovation
